description: 인천광역시_도로 교통량 통계 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천광역시. 인천광역시가 제공하는 도로 교통량 통계 API는 관내 주요 도로의 표준링크 단위로 집계된 일별 교통량에 대한 통계 데이터를 제공합니다. Coverage: 인천광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 인천광역시. Its tags are 도로, ITS, 교통정보, 교통량, 혼잡도. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
